items.question: What power is attributed to a yantra fashioned from copper?
premises: A yantra may be fashioned from specific materials.
This yantra is fashioned from copper.
Material composition determines the yantra's attributed effect.
items.inference: Therefore, a yantra fashioned from copper is considered to bestow all sovereignty.
items.plain_english: A yantra made of copper is considered to bestow all sovereignty.
